description: MCP tools exposed through the AgentCore Gateway (real: /gateway tool Lambda; mock: /mocks/mcp_tools_mock.py). Both load this file so names and input schemas cannot drift. Tool data comes from the loaded scenario (contracts/scenario.schema.json), never from code. The pre-call interceptor injects the caller's identity as the argument `burn_caller_agent_id`; it is NOT part of the public input schemas below, and a value sent by the agent is overwritten.

tools.name: list_tickets
tools.description: List open support tickets (id and subject).

tools.name: read_ticket
tools.description: Read one support ticket by id.

tools.name: read_config
tools.description: Read a configuration or log file by path.

path.description: File path, e.g. from a ticket.

tools.name: query_customers
tools.description: Look up customer records by name, email or customer id.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message to another agent. Only allowed recipients (from the scenario graph) are accepted.

tools.name: read_inbox
tools.description: Read and clear messages other agents sent to you.

tools.name: notify
tools.description: Send a notification to a customer or internal channel.
